cleansingStrength.rationale: Moderate: C1 ether/sulfonate chassis with Sodium Laureth Sulfate @2 as the defining anionic (C4), three prominent buffers (Cocamidopropyl Betaine @3, Decyl Glucoside @4, Coco-Glucoside @5) and no reinforcing strong anionic, so C1 yields moderate. Counter-signal toward low (glucoside-rich buffering) does not move a C1 value; no C3b member decides it.

conditioningLevel.rationale: High: C2 is met with a prominent payload_lipid in place of the early silicone (Dicaprylyl Ether @10, Hydrogenated Castor Oil @14), a cationic polymer (Guar Hydroxypropyltrimonium Chloride @9), a pearlizing/fatty route (Glycol Distearate @13) and a deliberate humectant (Glycerin @12); prominent lipid plus cationic is also W-RICH for conditioning (E3 reading). Counter-signal: every care route sits after Sodium Chloride @6, only one cationic polymer, no silicone, and Dicaprylyl Ether is a light emollient, so realistic unknowns could make it moderate.

excluded: Sodium Chloride @6, Citric Acid @7, Sodium Benzoate @15, Benzoic Acid @16 (non-deposition)

weightPotential.wLineRecord: wLine Sodium Benzoate @15 (preservative_or_capped_active); cap e3Point @18; no alphabetical run; no skipped candidates; no fallback codes; material payload_lipid: Dicaprylyl Ether @10, Hydrogenated Castor Oil @14; non-material: none.
weightPotential.depositionLoad: moderate: one cationic guar plus two material lipids (one light ether, one waxy) and a weak refatter, all after the salt.
weightPotential.persistence: moderate: the waxy Hydrogenated Castor Oil and guar can persist, Dicaprylyl Ether is a light emollient with low persistence; no silicone or film former.
weightPotential.resetCapacity: moderate: effective C1 chassis (SLES buffered by betaine and two glucosides), not limited and not strong.
weightPotential.counterevidence: W-RICH holds (material payload_lipid converging with a cationic polymer) and two deposition families (cationic_polymer + material payload_lipid) converge, which argues for high; against it, resetCapacity is moderate (not limited reset) and each route is single and mid-list.
weightPotential.whyThisBand: One meaningful cationic system plus material but light-to-moderate lipids leaves plausible, bounded conditioning residue; an effective ordinary sulfate chassis rinses it.
weightPotential.whyNotNeighborBand: Not high: W-RICH is present but resetCapacity is moderate, so the rich route is not open (W-RICH limited reset), and the convergence of one guar with a light ether lipid and a mid-list waxy lipid is not strong enough for a coating conclusion that the C1 reset fails to offset. Not low: two deposition families including material lipids make 'lightweight' an understatement (W2).
weightPotential.confidenceLimitingFactor: W-RICH with moderate reset: realistic unknowns (lipid and guar dose, guar charge density) could move it to high.
weightPotential.rationale: Moderate: W-RICH holds but reset is moderate, so per W-RICH limited-reset the band is moderate with W-RICH as counter-signal and high as neighbor; the convergence route is judged insufficient against the C1 reset. Not W1 (no silicone/amodimethicone set).
